_readme: Service pages under /services/<slug>/. Text may use {p:ITEM:COLUMN}, {now:HOME_ID}, {was:HOME_ID} and {fact:KEY} placeholders, filled from data/prices.json by tools/build_site.py, so prices are never typed twice. 'prices' lists price-list rows (ITEM:COLUMN) shown on the page; 'home' lists home-service offers. 'guide' links a related guide in content/guides/. 'mode': 'home' marks services done at the customer's home (changes the how-it-works steps). Optional 'start' (ITEM:COLUMN or home:ID) picks the 'Starting ₹X' price; otherwise the lowest listed price is used.

services.name: Laundry by KG
services.title: Laundry Service in Bhopal | Wash & Fold {p:wash-fold:price}/kg | Cleanzit

intro: Cleanzit's laundry-by-weight service is built for everyday clothes — shirts, T-shirts, jeans, kurtas, nightwear, towels and bed linen. We pick up from your door anywhere in Bhopal, wash, dry and either fold or steam iron, and deliver back within {fact:delivery_days} days.

You pay by weight, not per piece: Wash & Fold is {p:wash-fold:price}/kg, Wash & Steam Iron is {p:wash-iron:price}/kg and Premium Wash & Steam Iron is {p:premium-wash-iron:price}/kg. A kilogram is roughly five everyday garments.
includes: Doorstep pickup and delivery (free on orders above ₹{fact:free_pickup_min})
Individual tagging so every garment comes back to you
Folding, or steam ironing on the Wash & Steam Iron plans
Optional add-ons: starch (kalaf) and roll press
services.tips_title: Getting the most from laundry by kg
tips: Keep dry-clean-only pieces (silk, heavy embroidery, suits) out of the laundry bag — send those for dry cleaning instead.
Empty pockets: pens and tissues can mark a whole load.
Tell us about any stain when you hand over the bag so it can be pre-treated before washing.
Pick Wash & Fold for home clothes and towels, and Wash & Steam Iron for office and school wear.
faqs: How much does laundry cost per kg in Bhopal?

At Cleanzit, Wash & Fold is {p:wash-fold:price} per kg, Wash & Steam Iron is {p:wash-iron:price} per kg and Premium Wash & Steam Iron is {p:premium-wash-iron:price} per kg. New customers get {fact:first_order_off}% off the first order.
How many clothes are in 1 kg of laundry?
Roughly five everyday garments — for example a mix of shirts, T-shirts and trousers. Heavier items such as jeans and towels weigh more.

Pickup and delivery are free on orders above ₹{fact:free_pickup_min} anywhere in Bhopal.

Standard delivery is within {fact:delivery_days} days. Express same-day service is available for an extra charge — ask when you book.

intro: Some garments should never go in a washing machine: wool suits, blazers, silk sarees, embroidered kurtas and anything labelled dry clean only. Cleanzit dry cleans them with a process chosen for the fabric, not one method for everything.

Every piece is inspected before we accept it. If a garment carries a risk — a weak seam, loose embellishment, a colour that may bleed — we tell you before cleaning, not after. Prices start at {p:shirt:dry} for a shirt or trouser and {p:suit-2:dry} for a two-piece suit, with free pickup across Bhopal on orders above ₹{fact:free_pickup_min}.
includes: Steam finishing and a quality check
tips: Look for the circle symbol on the care label — it means the garment is meant for dry cleaning.
Point out stains and say what caused them (oil, turmeric, tea); the right pre-treatment depends on the stain.
Take garments out of the delivery plastic before storing them for long; fabric keeps better with airflow.
Clean seasonal clothes before putting them away — stains that are left sitting tend to set.
faqs: How much does dry cleaning cost in Bhopal?

At Cleanzit a shirt or trouser is {p:shirt:dry}, a coat or blazer {p:coat:dry}, a 2-piece suit {p:suit-2:dry} and a 3-piece suit {p:suit-3:dry}. Sarees start at {p:saree:dry}. See the full price list for every item.
What does the '+' after a price mean?
It means 'starting from'. The final price depends on the fabric, embroidery and condition of the garment — ask us for a quote when you book.
How long does dry cleaning take?
Standard delivery is within {fact:delivery_days} days. Express same-day service is available for an extra charge.
Will you tell me if a garment might get damaged?
Yes. Every garment is inspected first, and if it carries a risk we explain it before processing so you can decide.

services.name: Stain Removal
services.title: Stain Removal (Spotting) in Bhopal | Haldi, Oil, Tea | Cleanzit
services.short: Spot treatment for turmeric, oil, tea, ink and other stubborn stains.
intro: Turmeric, oil, tea, ink and food stains each need a different treatment, and the wrong one can set a stain for good. Cleanzit analyses each stain before cleaning and pre-treats it by type. Spotting (stain treatment) and colour enhancement are also available as additional services.

We're honest about results: fresh stains usually come out, but old or heat-set stains sometimes can't be fully removed. If we think a stain won't come out, or treating it carries a risk to the fabric, we tell you before we start.
includes: Spot pre-treatment matched to the stain
Spotting and colour enhancement as additional services
services.tips_title: Stain first aid before you call us
tips: Act fast — the fresher the stain, the better the chance of removing it.
Blot, don't rub: rubbing spreads a stain and pushes it into the fibres.
Rinse food and tea stains from the back of the fabric with cold water; hot water can set them.
For oil, sprinkle talc or cornflour to soak it up, then brush it off.
Don't iron over a stain — heat sets it.
faqs: Can you remove turmeric (haldi) stains?
Fresh turmeric stains usually respond well to treatment. Old ones are harder, so send the garment as soon as you can and tell us what caused the stain.
Is stain removal charged separately?
Spotting is one of our additional services — ask us when you book and we'll confirm.
Will every stain come out?
Not always. Old or heat-set stains sometimes can't be fully removed. We assess each stain first and tell you before treating it.
